scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The style emerged in the late 20th and early 21st centuries across the United States and Europe.
It evolved from the technical foundations of showgirl dance, which was the first style to perform technical choreography in heels, and was later shaped by the demands of the pop music video industry.

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: Stiletto dance is primarily a professional performance art used in the entertainment industry.
It also serves as a physical fitness discipline for women, focusing on movement vocabulary and body language.
Today it is a living tradition.
on_screen: Footage: unaputita_315 (https://archive.org/details/unaputita_315)

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: It is a solo dance characterized by dynamic footwork and torso isolations.
Dancers perform a mix of jazz-based steps, ballroom-influenced movements, and hip-hop isolations.
The technique includes significant floor work and fluid arm movements, all executed while wearing stiletto heels.
Watch for Torso Isolation, Floor work.
on_screen: Hero video — MISSING
Captions name each signature move as it appears
Formation: Solo performance; utilizes both vertical space and floor levels.
scenes.music: diegetic (the video's own sound), underscore under narration

scenes.title: Listen
narration: The dance is typically performed to pop and hip-hop music.
The rhythm and tempo are dictated by the commercial tracks used in music videos or stage performances, often featuring strong beats that support sharp isolations and rhythmic footwork.
Listen for the Synthesizers, Drum machines, Electronic bass, Vocals.
The pulse is 4/4 at about 109 beats a minute.
The sound is defined by modern commercial production, featuring heavy basslines and sharp percussive elements that facilitate the 'hits' and isolations in the choreography.

scenes.title: The people
narration: The style is practiced throughout the United States and Europe, though specific regional variations in technique are not detailed in the sources.
It descends from showgirl dance and incorporates elements from jazz, ballroom, Latin, belly dance, hip-hop, exotic dance, and contemporary dance.

scenes.title: Family tree
narration: Stiletto dance is parent of Jazz dance: Provides the foundational dynamic footwork.
Stiletto dance is parent of Showgirl dance: The first style of technical dance to be performed in heels.
Stiletto dance is influence of Hip hop dance: Source of torso isolations and contemporary music video context.
